title: Capture command output and cancel its execution
goal: Run a command that produces both output and diagnostics, and terminate it when the caller cancels.

selectionNotes: Buffers complete output in memory; cancellation kills the direct child, not an arbitrary process tree. macOS execution is unverified.

prerequisites: Use a net11.0 console project with LangVersion=15.0. Include the imports stated in the recipe.
constraints: Capture buffers complete output in memory; bound the command/output externally or stream large results. Run/RunAsync return status without collecting text. A started Process also exposes ReadAllText/ReadAllBytes and async equivalents; ReadAllLinesAsync yields Content and StandardError per line. Start both redirections before using these readers. Cross-stream ordering is not guaranteed. Process.RunAndCaptureTextAsync kills its direct child on cancellation; the older wrapper requests entireProcessTree=true, so these are not identical descendant policies. Cancellation can throw during reading or return a Canceled status during waiting; inspect both paths. Kill is asynchronous; cancellation is not proof that the OS has already reaped the child.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 verification; GA reconciliation remains pending.
macOS native execution is unverified; Pingu explicitly accepted this evidence gap.
